Selected Projects

Things I've shipped.

Real code, real repos — click any project to open on GitHub.

01
RAG · LLM · Full-Stack
UniBot — PDF Intelligence Chat
Built a document QA system that lets you upload any PDF and have a real conversation with it. Used LangChain to chunk documents semantically, embedded them with OpenAI's text-embedding model, and stored vectors in Pinecone. Unlike naive RAG, UniBot fetches top-k passages and re-ranks before sending to GPT-4, nearly eliminating hallucination on factual questions. FastAPI handles async routing; React + Vite frontend streams responses token-by-token. Useful for dense research papers, legal contracts, or financial reports without skimming 80 pages.
Python · FastAPI · LangChain · OpenAI · Pinecone · React · Vite · Docker
GitHub ↗
02
Real-time Analytics · Data Engineering
TigerScope — Sports Analytics Platform
Real-time sports dashboard ingesting live event streams with sub-200ms query latency. Kafka-based ingestion handles 50K+ events/hour, transforms with Spark Structured Streaming, materializes aggregates into Redis for instant reads. React frontend with WebSocket subscriptions updates stats live as games progress. ML layer uses gradient boosting for win probability estimation, re-running every 30 seconds against current game state.
Python · Kafka · Spark · Redis · React · WebSocket · XGBoost · PostgreSQL
GitHub ↗
03
Multimodal AI · Computer Vision · LLM
ClickLens AI — UX Behavior Analyzer
Multimodal RAG system combining computer vision and LLM reasoning to analyze user behavior from session recordings. Extracts frames at key interaction points, runs YOLO-based UI element detection, then sends structured data to an LLM that generates natural-language UX insights — friction points, drop-off patterns, specific redesign suggestions. The kind of analysis that normally requires a UX researcher watching 100 sessions manually.
Python · YOLOv8 · OpenCV · LangChain · OpenAI · ChromaDB · Streamlit
GitHub ↗
04
ML Engineering · Model Serving
ModelScope Lite — ML Model Hub
Lightweight model serving platform — register a trained model, write an inference function, instantly get a REST endpoint + auto-generated Swagger UI. Uses FastAPI for async serving, Redis for request caching (repeat inferences hit cache), Celery for async batch prediction jobs. Models versioned via PostgreSQL metadata store. Built to understand how production ML serving actually works beyond Jupyter notebooks.
Python · FastAPI · PyTorch · Scikit-learn · Redis · Celery · PostgreSQL · Docker
GitHub ↗
05
Time-Series · Forecasting · Hospitality
BookingPulse — Demand Forecasting
Demand forecasting system predicting hotel occupancy and feeding a dynamic pricing engine. Ensemble of ARIMA (seasonal structure) and XGBoost (non-linear features), trained on 3 years of booking data with lag features, holiday indicators, and local event signals. Achieved 89% directional accuracy on a 7-day rolling horizon. Pricing engine outputs room rate recommendations with confidence intervals. Delivered as Tableau dashboard ops teams use without touching any code.
Python · ARIMA · XGBoost · Pandas · Scikit-learn · Tableau · SQL
GitHub ↗
06
Deep Learning · Medical Imaging
Vision Care — Retinopathy Detection
Fine-tuned ResNet50 on APTOS 2019 to classify diabetic retinopathy across 5 severity levels from retinal fundus images. Applied Albumentations for aggressive augmentation to handle class imbalance in severe DR categories. Grad-CAM generates visual explanations showing which retinal regions drove each prediction — making the model interpretable for clinical users. Streamlit app: upload an image, get severity classification + heatmap overlay in seconds.
PyTorch · ResNet50 · Albumentations · Grad-CAM · OpenCV · Streamlit
